d: A 3,000-MW pumped-storage hydropower project in Maharashtra has put 32,400 trees on Saidongar Hill at risk. Located near Pali village and 16 km from the ecologically sensitive Bhimashankar Forest, the project has triggered protests by tribal residents, activists and politicians. After more than 1,000 trees were felled, the forest department temporarily halted the operation. What does this project mean for local tribal communities, Maharashtra’s forests and the climate? Pratip Acharya reports.
